name: Lanceolate
description: A narrow blade: rounded along its length and pointed at both ends.

code.style: --rule: ( --rot: @pick(0deg, 90deg, 180deg, 270deg); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 30%; right: 30%; top: 4%; bottom: 4%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); border-radius: 50% 50% 50% 50% / 24% 24% 24% 24%; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } -webkit-transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
